The Kingdom, is yours to explore.\n

Go questing, stare at your collection, or engage in glorious battle

These are the quintessential joys of life in the Kingdom.

Tap the '+' to create a deck. Tap a deck once to see options, twice to edit it.

The group of sage advisors has determined that you are to have not more than nine.

Nine is the limit. Not 8 and not 10.

Because the old buzzards said so, that is why.

Tap a deck to select it, then press Play.

Yes. It is complicated. You will get used to it.

If you're lucky the opponent will not figure this part out and you get to be champion.

These days, everyone needs a side hustle.

Your first choice determines your hero power.
The second adds to the card pool you build from.

Two personalities is not usually enough to become King but you never know...

Every card you own is here. The cards you wish you owned are here also.

Tap one to Render a copy, or to Reduce a spare into shards.

Cards come in 4 different rarity levels: 
Common - Pink, Rare - Blue, Epic - Purple, Legendary - Red.

The Decks button shows you the thing it says. Don't over think it.

Tap a card to add. Tap a row to subtract.

A deck is 30 cards, two copies max, only one of any Legendary.

Sing a snappy song to help you remember.

Tap Add, Tap Subtract. Tap your foot. Add tap, yep tap.

Drag packs to the center to open.

Pick one up and hold it over the rail to open more than one

Everything inside is yours. The paperwork has already been submitted

For most this would be a bad idea.

You are something special. I can tell.

You're going to go out there and make the kingdom a better place, I'm sure.

You don't have to be rich to become king.

If you toil every day doing quests, you might grow up to be one.

Or I overheard that once when I was young.

If you get into trouble in the kingdom you must try to tap your way out of it.

Just tap around on stuff; you might tap your way into some new cards.

Packs you buy end up in the Card Vault awaiting your tap.
